rationale: The public-infrastructure event ledger is trust-as-data, like the trust policy: the engine reads it, it never hardcodes trust. This file is the canonical, versioned home of the seed history of the public sources posture depends on (NVD, MITRE/CVE Program, EPSS, OSV). It lives beside posture/policy/policy.yaml so a change to how posture reads the upstream world is a dated, reviewable data edit, not a code change. Append-only: never rewrite a past event's facts, only add a superseding event and point the old one at it.
changelog: 2026-10-25.1: initial externalization of the six seed events from posture/source_history.py into this versioned data file. Content is byte-for-byte the same as the code seed it replaces.

events.summary: NVD moved to risk-based enrichment; many CVEs no longer carry CVSS vector / CPE applicability / EPSS-style data.
events.interpretation: The thin/unscored region is filled by OSV + EPSS overlays and (operator-gated) LLM drafts labeled source='llm:<model>'; nvd-thin rows are labeled and barred from the assess decide path until promoted.

events.summary: An authenticated broad-CPE pull with the API key in the URL query string returns 404 + empty body (the '404-masquerade'); a DELETE+INSERT recompute then wiped ~14000 fleet rows.
events.interpretation: Key is sent header-only (never in the query string); the per-device completeness gate means an empty/incomplete fetch preserves last-known-good verdicts instead of wiping them (run-#10 class).

events.summary: EPSS feed host epss.cyentific.com expired; feed relocated to epss.empiricalsecurity.com.
events.interpretation: EPSS URL is pinned and monitored; the exploitability-likelihood overlay (CVE-keyed, daily full refresh) fills the NVD enrichment-degradation scoring gap.

events.summary: CVE Program publishes cvelistV5 as the authoritative git-published CVE record stream (CVE JSON 5.0), superseding the legacy CVE List web downloads.
events.interpretation: The posture stream tick consumes cvelistV5 as the publication signal (skeletons only, rate-limit-free but git-fetch heavy); NVD enrichment runs as a separate paced per-CVE pass, not as the publication source.

events.summary: NVD API throttles at ~5 req/30s anonymous and ~50 req/30s with an API key.
events.interpretation: Ingestion is paced + incremental with a per-source budget and cap-resumed backfill; rate limits become natural throttling, not failures. The client never holds the NVD API key in the signed-spine topology.

events.summary: OSV mirrors NVD + GHSA plus many ecosystems (PyPI, npm, Crates, etc.) keyed by package@ecosystem with affected event-ranges, NOT by CPE.
events.interpretation: Consuming OSV/GHSA at assess needs a package matcher (ecosystem+name+version) alongside nvd_cpe and OSV-range decision logic over fixed_raw.ranges (tracked separately; not yet wired).
